_comment.vi: Mô tả bùa mê ban đầu

tooltip.enchdesc.activate.vi: Nhấn %s%s%s để xem mô tả bùa mê.

enchantment.minecraft.protection.desc.zh: 减少来自大多数来源的伤害。
enchantment.minecraft.protection.desc.vi: Giảm thiệt hại từ hầu hết các nguồn.

enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de.en: Reduces the effects of fire damage. Also reduces the burn time when set on fire.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de.zh: 减少火焰伤害的效果。同时减少着火时的燃烧时间。
enchantment.minecraft.fire_protection.de.vi: Giảm hiệu ứng sát thương của lửa. Đồng thời làm giảm thời gian cháy trong trường hợp hỏa hoạn.

enchantment.minecraft.feather_falling.de.en: Reduces fall damage and ender pearl teleportation damage.
enchantment.minecraft.feather_falling.de.zh: 减少摔落伤害和末影珍珠传送伤害。
enchantment.minecraft.feather_falling.de.vi: Giảm sát thương khi rơi và sát thương dịch chuyển ngọc trai cuối cùng.

enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d.en: Reduces damage from explosions and explosion knockback.
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d.zh: 减少爆炸伤害和爆炸击退效果。
enchantment.minecraft.blast_protection.d.vi: Giảm sát thương vụ nổ và đánh bật vụ nổ.

enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect.en: Reduces damage from projectiles such as arrows and fire balls.
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect.zh: 减少来自如箭矢和火球等弹射物的伤害。
enchantment.minecraft.projectile_protect.vi: Giảm sát thương từ các loại đạn như mũi tên và quả cầu lửa.

enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc.en: Allows the user to breathe longer underwater.
enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc.zh: 延长玩家在水下的时间。同时改善水下视野。
enchantment.minecraft.respiration.desc.vi: Kéo dài thời gian người chơi có thể ở dưới nước. Cũng cải thiện tầm nhìn dưới nước.

enchantment.minecraft.aqua_affinity.desc.zh: 提高在水下的挖掘速度。
enchantment.minecraft.aqua_affinity.desc.vi: Tăng tốc độ đào dưới nước.

enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc.en: Causes damage to enemies when they attack you.
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc.zh: 当敌人攻击你时，对敌人造成伤害。
enchantment.minecraft.thorns.desc.vi: Khi kẻ địch tấn công bạn, hãy gây sát thương cho kẻ địch.

enchantment.minecraft.sharpness.desc.en: Increases the damage of the item.
enchantment.minecraft.sharpness.desc.vi: Tăng sức tấn công của vũ khí.

enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc.en: Increases damage against undead mobs such as Zombies and Skeletons.
enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc.zh: 增加对亡灵生物（如僵尸和骷髅）的伤害。
enchantment.minecraft.smite.desc.vi: Tăng sát thương chống lại các sinh vật bất tử như zombie và bộ xương.

enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods.en: Increases damage against arthropods such as Spiders and Silverfish.
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods.zh: 增加对节肢动物（如蜘蛛和蠹虫）的伤害。
enchantment.minecraft.bane_of_arthropods.vi: Tăng sát thương cho động vật chân đốt như nhện và cá bạc.

enchantment.minecraft.knockback.desc.en: Increases the knockback strength of the weapon.
enchantment.minecraft.knockback.desc.vi: Tăng hiệu ứng đẩy lùi của vũ khí.

enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc.en: Causes additional fire damage when used to attack a mob.
enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc.zh: 攻击生物时造成额外的火焰伤害。
enchantment.minecraft.fire_aspect.desc.vi: Gây thêm sát thương lửa khi tấn công sinh vật.

enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc.en: Mobs will drop more loot when killed.
enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc.zh: 杀死生物时，生物会掉落更多战利品。
enchantment.minecraft.looting.desc.vi: Mob rơi ra nhiều chiến lợi phẩm hơn khi bị giết.

enchantment.minecraft.efficiency.desc.en: Increases mining speed of the tool.
enchantment.minecraft.efficiency.desc.vi: Tăng tốc độ đào của công cụ.

enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc.en: Allows fragile blocks such as glass to be collected.
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc.zh: 允许收集易碎的方块，如玻璃。
enchantment.minecraft.silk_touch.desc.vi: Cho phép thu thập các khối dễ vỡ như thủy tinh.

enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc.en: Causes the tool to lose durability at a slower rate.
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc.zh: 使工具的耐久度下降速度减慢。
enchantment.minecraft.unbreaking.desc.vi: Làm chậm quá trình mất độ bền của công cụ.

enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc.en: Some blocks like coal and diamond ore may drop additional items.
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc.zh: 对一些方块，如煤和钻石矿石，可能会掉落额外的物品。
enchantment.minecraft.fortune.desc.vi: Một số khối, chẳng hạn như than đá và quặng kim cương, có thể rơi ra các vật phẩm bổ sung.

enchantment.minecraft.power.desc.en: Increases the damage of arrows fired from the bow.
enchantment.minecraft.power.desc.zh: 增加弓射出的箭的伤害。
enchantment.minecraft.power.desc.vi: Tăng sát thương của mũi tên bắn ra từ cung.

enchantment.minecraft.punch.desc.en: Increases the knockback strength of arrows fired by the bow.
enchantment.minecraft.punch.desc.zh: 增加弓射出的箭的击退强度。
enchantment.minecraft.punch.desc.vi: Tăng sức mạnh đánh bật của mũi tên bắn ra từ cung.

enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc.en: Arrows fired from the bow will deal additional fire damage.
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc.zh: 弓射出的箭将造成额外的火焰伤害。
enchantment.minecraft.flame.desc.vi: Mũi tên bắn ra từ cung gây thêm sát thương lửa.

enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc.en: Allows the bow to fire normal arrows for free. You must have at least one arrow for this to work.
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc.zh: 允许弓免费射出普通箭矢。至少需要一支箭才能生效。
enchantment.minecraft.infinity.desc.vi: Cho phép cung bắn tên bình thường miễn phí. Cần ít nhất một mũi tên để có hiệu quả.

enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de.en: Increases the chance of getting good loot while fishing.
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de.zh: 增加钓鱼时获得优质战利品的几率。
enchantment.minecraft.luck_of_the_sea.de.vi: Tăng cơ hội nhận được chiến lợi phẩm chất lượng khi câu cá.

enchantment.minecraft.lure.desc.en: Decreases the amount of time it takes for a fish to bite the hook.
enchantment.minecraft.lure.desc.zh: 减少鱼咬钩所需的时间。
enchantment.minecraft.lure.desc.vi: Giảm thời gian cá cắn câu.

enchantment.minecraft.depth_strider.desc.zh: 增加在水下的移动速度。
enchantment.minecraft.depth_strider.desc.vi: Tăng tốc độ di chuyển dưới nước.

enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc.en: Water under the user will freeze into frosted ice.
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc.zh: 将玩家脚下的水冻结成霜冰。
enchantment.minecraft.frost_walker.desc.vi: Đóng băng nước dưới chân người chơi thành băng giá.

enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc.en: Repairs the durability of armor and tools with XP.
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc.zh: 使用经验值修复盔甲和工具的耐久度。
enchantment.minecraft.mending.desc.vi: Sử dụng điểm kinh nghiệm để sửa chữa độ bền của áo giáp và công cụ.

enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc.en: Prevents the cursed item from being removed from an armor slot.
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc.zh: 防止诅咒物品从盔甲槽中被移除。
enchantment.minecraft.binding_curse.desc.vi: Ngăn chặn việc vật phẩm bị nguyền rủa bị lấy ra khỏi khe áo giáp.

enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de.en: Destroys the cursed item if you die with it in your inventory.
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de.zh: 如果玩家在携带诅咒物品时死亡，该物品将被销毁。
enchantment.minecraft.vanishing_curse.de.vi: Nếu người chơi chết khi đang mang theo vật phẩm bị nguyền rủa, vật phẩm đó sẽ bị phá hủy.

enchantment.minecraft.sweeping.desc.en: Increases the damage of sweeping attacks.
enchantment.minecraft.sweeping.desc.vi: Tăng sát thương của các đòn tấn công quét.

enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc.en: Allows the trident to automatically return after being thrown.
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc.zh: 允许三叉戟在被投掷后自动返回。
enchantment.minecraft.loyalty.desc.vi: Cho phép cây đinh ba tự động quay trở lại sau khi bị ném đi.

enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc.zh: 增加对水生生物的伤害。
enchantment.minecraft.impaling.desc.vi: Tăng thiệt hại cho đời sống thủy sinh.

enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc.en: Using the trident while in rain or water will launch the user forward.
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc.zh: 允许玩家随着三叉戟一同飞出。仅在下雨或水中有效。
enchantment.minecraft.riptide.desc.vi: Cho phép người chơi bay ra ngoài bằng cây đinh ba. Chỉ hiệu quả khi trời mưa hoặc nước.

enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc.en: Allows the trident to summon lightning bolts during thunderstorms.
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc.zh: 允许三叉戟在雷雨期间召唤闪电。
enchantment.minecraft.channeling.desc.vi: Cho phép cây đinh ba triệu hồi tia sét khi có giông bão.

enchantment.minecraft.multishot.desc.en: Fires additional arrows in similar directions.

enchantment.minecraft.quick_charge.desc.en: Increases the reload speed of crossbows.
enchantment.minecraft.quick_charge.desc.vi: Tăng tốc độ nạp lại nỏ.

enchantment.minecraft.piercing.desc.en: Allows projectiles to pierce through mobs.
enchantment.minecraft.piercing.desc.vi: Cho phép đạn xuyên qua sinh vật.

enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc.en: Increases movement speed on soul blocks.
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc.zh: 增加在灵魂方块上的移动速度。
enchantment.minecraft.soul_speed.desc.vi: Tăng tốc độ di chuyển trên các khối linh hồn.

enchantment.minecraft.swift_sneak.desc.zh: 增加潜行时的移动速度。
enchantment.minecraft.swift_sneak.desc.vi: Tăng tốc độ di chuyển khi lén lút.

enchdesc.activate.message.en: Hold shift to view enchantment descriptions.

enchantment.gofish.deepfry.desc.en: Reeling in certain fish will cook them.

enchantment.shieldsplus.reinforced.desc.en: Increases amount of damage blocked by shields.

enchantment.shieldsplus.ablaze.desc.en: Sets attackers and projectiles on fire.

enchantment.shieldsplus.lightweight.desc.en: Allows the user to move faster when blocking.

enchantment.shieldsplus.shield_bash.desc.en: Gives the shield a bash attack.

enchantment.grapplemod.wallrunenchantmen.en: Allows the user to run on walls.

enchantment.grapplemod.doublejumpenchant.en: Allows the user to jump twice.

enchantment.grapplemod.slidingenchantmen.en: Allows the user to slide using built up momentum.

enchantment.hunterillager.bounce.desc.en: Increases how much boomerangs will bounce off walls.

enchantment.betterarcheology.penetrating.en: Some damage will bypass protection enchantments.

enchantment.betterarcheology.seas_bounty.en: Allows you to catch more types of treasure.

enchantment.betterarcheology.soaring_win.en: Gives the elytra a boost when taking off.

enchantment.betterarcheology.tunneling.d.en: Mines the block below the target block as well.

enchantment.deeperdarker.catalysis.desc.en: Killing mobs will spread sculk nearby.

enchantment.deeperdarker.sculk_smite.des.en: Increases damage to sculk based mobs.

enchantment.endlessbiomes.vwooping.desc.en: Enemies that attack you may be teleported away.

enchantment.endlessbiomes.shared_pain.en: When a mob is killed any excess damage will be dealt to nearby mobs.

enchantment.stalwart_dungeons.thunder_st.en: Gives hammers the ability to summon lightning.

enchantment.dungeonsenchantments.thunder.en: Attacks strike the target with lightning.

enchantment.dungeonsenchantments.deflect.en: Arrows may deflect back at the shooter.

enchantment.dungeonsenchantments.guardin.en: Defeating enemies boosts your defence temporarily.

enchantment.dungeonsenchantments.leechin.en: Defeating enemies will heal the user.

enchantment.dungeonsenchantments.rush.de.en: Temporarily increases speed after the user is hurt.

enchantment.dungeonsenchantments.cowardi.en: Attacks do more damage when the users health is full.

enchantment.dungeonsenchantments.illager.en: Attacks do more damage against illagers.

enchantment.dungeonsenchantments.pain_cy.en: Attacks hurt the user. Every fifth attack deals massive damage.

enchantment.dungeonsenchantments.ambush..en: Attacks deal extra damage to enemies that are not looking at you.

enchantment.dungeonsenchantments.recycle.en: Being hit by projectiles sometimes produces arrows.

enchantment.create_sa.gravity_gun.desc.en: Allows the Block Picker to move and throw entities.

enchantment.create_sa.impact.desc.en: Allows the Grapplin Whisk to do a small burst of AOE damage.

enchantment.create_sa.digging.desc.en: Allows the drill to dig a bigger hole.

enchantment.create_sa.hellfire.desc.en: Increases the damage of the flamethrower and place fire.

enchantment.improved_exp.detection.desc.en: Attacks will make the target glow.

enchantment.improved_exp.autosmelt.desc.en: Breaking a block will smelt it instead.

enchantment.improved_exp.pain_relief.des.en: Holding shift will use EXP to regenerate health.

enchantment.improved_exp.coldblooded.des.en: The user takes damage in warm biomes.

enchantment.improved_exp.flammable.desc.en: Damages the wearer in direct sunlight.

enchantment.improved_exp.habitual_place..en: Grants the wearer buffs in different dimensions.

enchantment.improved_exp.in_all_seriousn.en: Increases the wearers speed when their health is low.

enchantment.improved_exp.random_teleport.en: Teleports the user in a random direction.

enchantment.improved_exp.suspicious_look.en: Mobs will stare at the wearer.

enchantment.improved_exp.resistance.desc.en: Gives the wearer the resistance buff.

enchantment.improved_exp.fear_of_depth.d.en: Damages the wearer while deep below water.

enchantment.improved_exp.water_breathing.en: Allows the wearer to breath under water.

enchantment.improved_exp.bakingpowder.de.en: Allows the hoe to till multiple blocks at once.

enchantment.improved_exp.machine_gun.des.en: Reduces charge time of the bow.

enchantment.improved_exp.passage.desc.en: The user will fly towards what they look at.

enchantment.improved_exp.preview.desc.en: The users camera rotates to the right.

enchantment.improved_exp.evasion.desc.en: Allows the wearer to avoid damage.

enchantment.improved_exp.explosive.desc.en: When the user is low on health they will explode.

enchantment.improved_exp.night_vision.de.en: Allows the wearer to see in the dark.

enchantment.improved_exp.poisonous_water.en: The wearer is poisoned while in water.

enchantment.improved_exp.harm.desc.en: Removes all buffs from the wearer.

enchantment.improved_exp.pinger.desc.en: Warns the user when durability is low.

enchantment.improved_exp.warmblooded.des.en: Damages the wearer in cold biomes.

enchantment.improved_exp.night.desc.en: The wearer takes damage if they can not see the sky.

enchantment.improved_exp.return_from_voi.en: Teleports the wearer back to the surface if they fall into the void.

enchantment.improved_exp.healing_waters..en: The wearer is healed while in water.

enchantment.improved_exp.strength.desc.en: Increases the attack damage of the wearer.

enchantment.improved_exp.invulnerability.en: The wearer does not take damage.

enchantment.improved_exp.true_shot.desc.en: Arrows are fired with more power.

enchantment.improved_exp.quick_kill.desc.en: Attacks have a chance to immediately kill the target

enchantment.improved_exp.weakness.desc.en: The wearer will take more damage than normal.

enchantment.improved_exp.fear_of_dark.de.en: The wearer takes damage in the dark.

enchantment.improved_exp.naturalfertiliz.en: Using the hoe has a chance to create bonemeal.

enchantment.improved_exp.professional_ri.en: The wearer can ride any mob.

enchantment.improved_exp.collector.desc.en: Killing a mob may drop a spawn egg of that mob.

enchantment.improved_exp.planeswalker.de.en: Allows the wearer to change dimensions using keybinds.

enchantment.improved_exp.golden_fever.de.en: Blocks have a chance to drop gold nuggets.

enchantment.improved_exp.gravity.desc.en: Right clicking a block will pull nearby entities in.

enchantment.improved_exp.blindness.desc.en: Reduces the vision of the wearer.

enchantment.improved_exp.telekinesis.des.en: Looking at an entity will pull them towards you.

enchantment.improved_exp.rebound.desc.en: Pressing the R key will make the user bounce backwards.

enchantment.improved_exp.constant_survei.en: The wearer is forced to look at the nearest mob.

enchantment.improved_exp.fire_resistance.en: The wearer is immune to fire damage.

enchantment.improved_exp.spurt.desc.en: Pressing the R key will thrust the player in the direction they are looking.

enchantment.improved_exp.magnet.desc.en: Block drops are pulled towards the user.

enchantment.improved_exp.easy_movement.d.en: Increases movement speed on certain blocks.

enchantment.improved_exp.treatment.desc.en: Removes negative effects from the wearer.

enchantment.improved_exp.hungry.desc.en: The wearer constantly loses hunger and saturation points.

enchantment.improved_exp.jumper.desc.en: Allows the wearer to jump while in the air.

enchantment.improved_exp.oxidation.desc.en: Attacks deal more damage to the targets armor.

enchantment.improved_exp.bury.desc.en: Attacking an entity will push them into the ground.

enchantment.improved_exp.recovery.desc.en: The user is healed when they attack others.

enchantment.improved_exp.fertilizing.des.en: Pressing the Z key will bonemeal nearby blocks.

enchantment.improved_exp.dolphins_grace..en: The wearer moves faster in water.

enchantment.improved_exp.lavawalker.desc.en: Lava blocks nearby will freeze into obsidian.

enchantment.improved_exp.absorption.desc.en: Gives the wearer the absorption effect.

enchantment.improved_exp.ore_detector.de.en: Using the right mouse button will tell the user about nearby ores.

enchantment.improved_exp.werewolf.desc.en: Grants the wearer buffs based on the current moon phase.

enchantment.improved_exp.fear_of_height..en: The wearer will take damage if they are too high.

enchantment.galosphere.rupture.desc.en: Shatters the saltbound tablet's pillars into shard projectiles once they break.

enchantment.galosphere.sustain.desc.en: Extends the duration of the saltbound tablet's pillars.

enchantment.galosphere.enfeeble.desc.en: Inflicts slowness on entities hit by the saltbound tablet's pillars.
